title: P1 continuation packet preserves the established forward and inverse methods
question: After the P0-R release-gated seal and the EXP-001316 platform boundary, what is the smallest next packet that advances the existing T-054 and T-059 methods without reopening parked finite variants or changing any owner order?
method: Verify the release-gated local and remote checkpoint and read the current programme, live task records, T-054 R-445 boundary, and T-061 EXP-001316 boundary.

Separate the forward obligation (an actual owner-declared common weighted-domain Q3LOCK commutator/history-tail majorant) from the inverse obligation (a reproducible supported GTS/GDT environment or pinned source-build lock before event-free execution).
Check the stopped-loop registry so that no equivalent finite grid, static-to-dynamic fit, physical-empty placeholder, or unsupported package substitution is emitted as a new proof step.
Freeze lane-specific acceptance, falsifier, and stop conditions as a continuation packet; do not alter the established theorem order, candidate definitions, promotion firewalls, or claim tiers.
finding: P0-R is durably complete at the release-gated main head, while both scientific lanes remain P1-active. T-054 has a reusable conditional scalar-to-operator transfer (R-445), but its actual Q3LOCK per-edge majorant and common weighted operator domain are not supplied; the next admissible forward step is an analytic owner-level derivation, not another finite table. T-059/T-061 have hash-pinned inputs and finite public-code evidence, but the exact astro-gdt healpy~=1.18.0 dependency has no queried Windows wheel or conda win-64 binary; the next admissible inverse step is a supported-platform or fully pinned source-build lock, not a minor-version substitution or event score.
decision_reason: This packet makes the already-issued P1 continuation actions explicit and durable after the P0-R seal. It preserves the existing forward and observation-first inverse methods, converts no finite or environment evidence into a higher layer, and prevents the two parked repeat loops from being reopened without their registered reopen conditions.
decision_scope: T0 repository-continuity and route-scheduling checkpoint only. It records the next proof-owner and observation-owner actions; it introduces no theorem, physical identification, candidate selection, empirical score, continuum limit, or tier change.
evidence_level: T0 release-gated continuity and owner-boundary crosswalk
